implemented: Grid Y is 80+100*row on day/night, 80+85*row on pool/fog, and 70+85*row+20*max(0,5-column) on roofs.
Cabbage, kernel, butter, melon and wintermelon emit at native grid top-left plus (5,-12), (19,-37), (12,-56), (25,-46), (25,-46), with a further -5 Y when a flowerpot is present.
All49 ordinary plant reanim families render raw source transforms at native grid roots, with species heights and source pot support; live potato/coffee use scale0.8 with their12px offsets.
Rendering in pool rows includes the source two-pixel sine bob. Projectile emission does not inherit that animation.

Actual plants and cursor previews share the same base positioning method. No bitmap or display object was added. Native cached cursor poses/scales, time-varying body offsets and several emissions remain unported.
auditCorrection: The earlier 80-case audit stopped reading Plant::Fire before its common flowerpot branch and incorrectly described emission as having no pot adjustment. Lines after the weapon-specific origins explicitly subtract 5. The new tests cover both occupied and unoccupied pot cells and both kernel weapons. The earlier report remains historical evidence of a discrepancy, not the final source oracle.
remaining: Zombie phases outside the currently mapped ground families still retain their previous position bridge.
Pult targets use mapped native body tops when available; unsupported phases keep the fallback. Non-pult emissions require a joint body/head-clock/native-origin port.
Dynamic plant shake, wake/stretch and gravebuster landing/sink, cached cursor art, sleep/health overlays and whole-native pixel comparison remain.
Physical iPhone/Safari touch, long-play CPU, memory, battery and thermal acceptance are not completed.
